name: swap-aggressive
description: Prioritize sustained random 4K perf and endurance for Linux swap. Trades capacity for performance and lifetime.

capacity_impact.method: usable ≈ advertised × (1 − OP/100) × (1 − pSLC/100), rounded down. Exact result depends on how the controller counts pSLC (some count against OP, some against user capacity).

host_recommendations.partition_scheme: GPT, single partition, type=Linux swap (GUID 0657FD6D-A4AB-43C4-84E5-0933C84B4F4F; sgdisk typecode 8200)
notes: No filesystem on the partition — swapon talks to raw blocks for latency.
macOS cannot redirect swap to external devices; this profile is Linux-only in practice.
Thermal: USB sticks regularly hit 70-85°C under sustained swap. Verify your enclosure allows airflow or use a metal-cased drive.
Endurance: ~2-5× factory lifetime at this OP level, but swap writes constantly — expect multi-month to multi-year lifespan depending on load.
Hibernation image goes to swap too; if you hibernate, back up anything sensitive before relying on this drive long-term.
